messages:
maya (Support): FYI customer reported a 403 on Billing after SSO sync earlier today. They see 'You don't have permission to view this page (403)'.

maya (Support): Customer tenant: acme-corp, org_id=4321. User: alice@acme.com. They can access other org pages but Billing and Usage pages return 403.

jordan (Customer Success): Thanks maya. Did they try incognito / different browser? Any console errors?

maya (Support): They tried incognito, same result. No client-side JS errors, response is from backend API. They sent curl repro:

```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <session_token_from_browser>" \
  "https://console.redwood.ai/api/orgs/4321/billing"

HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
Content-Type: application/json

{"error":"permission_denied","message":"You do not have permission to view billing for this org"}
```

maya (Support): They also tried the REST API with a personal API key (org-scoped key) and got 403 as well.

liam (Eng-Identity): tagging in. @maya can you paste the SAML assertion (stripped) or the Okta group sync payload? I want to check if redwood role claims are present.

maya (Support): Pasting SAML attributes (sanitized):

```
attributes: {
  email: "alice@acme.com",
  uid: "alice",
  groups: ["acme::engineers", "acme::finance_view"],
  // note: no 'redwood_role' attribute present
}
```

liam (Eng-Identity): Hmm that matches my suspicion. Billing pages require the user to be mapped to either org_admin or billing_admin role via the SSO/group mapping. Looks like the group->role mapping for acme::finance_view got dropped in yesterday's Okta push.

liam (Eng-Identity): I pulled the connector logs: okta-bot: group-sync job 2026-02-16T03:22:11Z returned 200 but with truncated attributes for a subset of tenants due to a malformed rule introduced in the mapping config: `replace(regex(.+), "")` — that cleared custom role attribute for groups matching `.*::finance.*`.

sre-bot: incident-note: suspected regression in okta group-to-role mapping; initial scope limited to tenants with '::finance' groups.

jordan (Customer Success): Can we fix quickly and give acme a temporary workaround? They are trying to pay an invoice.

liam (Eng-Identity): Short term workaround: create a temporary org-scoped invite for alice@acme.com and grant org_admin via console (manual). Long term: I will revert the bad mapping rule and re-run group-sync. Will also trigger a targeted re-push for org_id=4321.

liam (Eng-Identity): Action plan:
- Revert bad mapping config (in Okta admin UI) -> ETA 15m
- Run group-sync for affected tenants -> ETA 10m after revert
- Validate SAML assertion contains `redwood_role` claim for alice -> ETA 5m
- Notify CS to confirm restored access -> ETA 5m

maya (Support): I've created a temporary org invite for alice@acme.com and granted org_admin. Told them to wait ~20m while we rollout.

liam (Eng-Identity): Revert done. Running backfill now for acme-corp (org_id=4321). Logs: `group-sync: success: 47 groups processed, 1 mapping restored (acme::finance_view -> billing_admin)`.

okta-bot: push-complete: group-sync finished for org_id=4321 at 2026-02-16T03:38:02Z.

liam (Eng-Identity): I can see SAML now includes: `redwood_role: ["billing_admin"]` for alice. Please verify.

jordan (Customer Success): Pinged customer, they say they can now access Billing and download invoice. Confirmed no 403. :tada:

maya (Support): Closing loop with customer. They were very happy. Marking as resolved.

liam (Eng-Identity): Follow-ups:
- Add a unit/integration test on the mapping rule parsing in our Okta connector.
- Add an alert when group-sync removes all custom role attributes for a tenant (sensible guardrail).
- Add a short postmortem note in incidents channel.

jordan (Customer Success): I'll update the customer-facing incident summary and offer a credit for the billing delay.

maya (Support): TL;DR: root cause = bad Okta mapping rule introduced yesterday that stripped `redwood_role` for finance groups -> caused billing_admin role to be missing -> 403 on billing pages. Fix reverted and group-sync backfilled -> access restored.

liam (Eng-Identity): Thanks all. (reaction: :white_check_mark:).

sre-bot: remind: create incident doc in sources/incidents within 48h (automated).
